answer.rationale: p99 latency is 5x target and confined to primary region during peak settlement traffic. Rollback is blocked by compliance mandate on security patch. Regional failover (memory_b2) successfully restored latency during March degradation with clean traffic shift and recovery within minutes. This preserves the mandatory security patch, avoids capacity-adding delays, maintains write integrity during peak load, and is proven low-risk in this infrastructure. Circuit breaker and read-replica routing do not address primary write-path latency. Verification of memory_b2 confirms failover reliability before commitment.
